$comment: Stories the Bard produced. Newest first — index.html renders stories[0]. Nothing here is written by a person; if a field cannot be filled honestly, leave it out rather than guessing. See ../README.md for how device stories will reach this file.

schema.title: string — the tale's opening phrase, for the page heading
schema.text: string — the generated text, verbatim, no editing
schema.origin: "device" (a chip in the field) | "reference" (the same weights on a host)
schema.node: string — sigil node name, device origin only
schema.version: string — firmware version that produced it
schema.provenance: string — how this text is known to be genuine

stories.title: The girl and the red ball
stories.text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she saw a big, red ball. She wanted to play with it, but it was too high
stories.provenance: Greedy decode from BOS at temperature 0 — the model's deterministic opening, so the same weights emit this same text every time. Recorded during the smol#300 port and verified bit-for-bit against an independent Python reference implementation. Not an on-device capture: it is what the device says, established on a host. The first true device capture replaces it.
